versions.changelog:
fec-image-generation v2.9.0

- Added diagram QA and compatibility sample assets, including real-world architecture, workflow, and sequence diagram examples.
- Introduced new scripts for diagram rendering, layout analysis, live previews, and robust PNG quality assurance (diagram-browser.mjs, diagram-layout.mjs, mermaid-render.mjs, png-qa.mjs).
- Enhanced workflow descriptions to cover browser-specific and non-Mermaid process routes and compatibility considerations.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md; license and asset documentation files added.
- Documentation now clarifies HTML workflow diagram selection and expands compatibility for browser-based diagram delivery.

– Adds interactive and themed HTML technical diagrams, plus new scripts
- Added support for browser-ready HTML technical diagrams with themes, semantic node shapes, and flow-aware arrows for system blueprints and architecture maps.
- Introduced scripts for diagram rendering, export, and interactive live editing: `tech-diagram-render.mjs`, `export-diagram.mjs`, and `interactive-diagram-server.mjs`.
- Added assets and documentation for interactive diagrams and HTML diagram workflows.
- Updated workflow to include interactive live diagrams and session-based creation/editing in the browser.
- Expanded documentation on using HTML diagrams for workflows, architecture, agent/memory flows, and delivery themes.
- Removed deprecated output documentation (`skill-card.md`).

- Added expanded documentation detailing workflows for generating and editing diagrams, images, and visual assets, including PNG export, automated QA, and iterative self-repair.
- Clarified input requirements, recommended source formats, and output expectations for different artifact and asset types.
- Introduced automated PNG QA and repair loop process, with command line usage examples and step-wise procedures.
- Specified new constraints for source editability, proper labeling, visual clarity, and compliance with brand and regulatory needs.
- Outlined delivery requirements: include source, export path, QA rounds, and unresolved risks.
